summary.text: ALVØEN SERVICE AS (918 864 741), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 2017-03-23; address Godviksvingene 121, 5179 GODVIK, Norge. Main industry is Construction of residential and non-residential buildings (41.000); 6 registered employees; 1 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Lukasz Nedzi; Board chair: Lukasz Nedzi. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 6.59 m, operating profit NOK 159.88 k, net profit NOK 125.38 k, equity NOK 78.75 k, total assets NOK 703.25 k. Official website https://alvoenservice.no/ is verified (the org number appears on the site).
